name: Mobbing Assault
text:
Requirements Your horde has been raised

---
Effect Each enemy in a 5-foot emanation around your horde takes ternary(gte(@actor.level,18,8,ternarygte(@actor.level,14,6,ternarygte(@actor.level,10,4,2))))d6 bludgeoning damage (if your horde is zombies) or ternary(gte(@actor.level,18,8,ternarygte(@actor.level,14,6,ternarygte(@actor.level,10,4,2))))d6 slashing damage (if your horde is skeletons) with a basic Reflex save save against your spell DC. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the damage increases by 2d6.
